Callout.Name: Narcotics - Warehouse Raid
Callout.Message: Warrant for a warehouse believed to hold narcotics.

Script.Line: The shutter is down. Nobody is inside.
I am the night watchman. That is the job.
They came at four and they left at four. I am not making that up.

Stages.Stage: The shutter is coming up on its own.
They are not coming out. They are going for the yard.
Yard secured and the seizure is starting.

Lines.Approach: The shutter is down, there is movement inside, and the warrant covers all of it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
